visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a hand using a metal spoon to scoop thick, textured brown bean paste from a glass jar with a gold lid. (2) A hand holds a tall glass bottle of dark liquid, rotating it to display the detailed ingredient label on the back. (3) The scene shifts to a medium shot of a gift box labeled with traditional Chinese characters, next to which a hand displays large, thick-capped dried shiitake mushrooms. (4) A hand is seen stirring a dark, syrupy liquid in a small glass bowl with a spoon, highlighting its viscosity. (5) Two men, one in a white chef's coat and another in a light blue shirt, stand behind a counter in a bright studio environment, gesturing enthusiastically toward an array of gift-packaged food products while speaking directly to the camera.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: Two main male hosts presenting the products.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: One host wears a professional white chef's coat; the other wears a light blue casual button-down shirt. Both have short black hair and appear middle-aged.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A bright indoor studio set featuring a white brick-style wall. There are festive red decorations, including Lunar New Year ornaments, and a table displaying multiple food gift boxes and jars.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male voice introduces the bean paste over an upbeat, major-key pop backing track with acoustic guitar and piano. There is a metallic 'clink' as a spoon touches a jar. (2) The narration becomes faster as he lists health-conscious ingredients, with clear articulation and high arousal. Background music continues with a steady drum beat. (3) The sound of light plastic rustling is heard as mushrooms are presented. The tone shifts to professional storytelling, highlighting the quality of the 'winter mushrooms'. (4) A quick 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a transition to the soy sauce demonstration. The voice remains optimistic and inviting. (5) Both hosts' voices overlap slightly as they enthusiastically announce five gift set options, with the background music swelling in volume to emphasize the celebratory Lunar New Year theme.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Feature Showcase -> Value Proposition -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional commercial designed to drive sales for 'Heidousang' food products during the Lunar New Year. It highlights the quality of ingredients (non-GMO, no additives) and offers multiple gift set options to appeal to holiday shoppers seeking high-quality food gifts.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of products, brand logos, and discount pricing with a call to visit the official website.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly effective commercial using social-media native editing, fast pacing, and clear on-screen text to convey value quickly.
